headline: GOLD SLIDES TO $4,350 AS FED RATE HIKE ODDS HIT 66% — Silver Drops 2.77%; Hormuz Strikes Reinforce September Hike Case
snippet: Gold fell to $4,331–$4,369/oz on September 1 as CME FedWatch odds for a 25bp September rate hike climbed to 66.4%, following Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks that the Fed has 'work to do.' Silver dropped 2.77% to $64.72. US strikes on a Strait of Hormuz island prompted Iranian retaliation against the UAE and Jordan, keeping oil elevated and paradoxically adding near-term headwind to metals by reinforcing the rate-hike case. Despite the selloff, gold remains up 23% year-on-year and has held the $4,350 level that prior GDX re-rating cycles suggest is the medium-term floor.

headline: CASCADIA DRILLS 52.84m AT 1.04% COPPER AT CARMACKS — Zone 2000S Strike Doubles; Yukon Program Expanded To 18,000m To Chase Northern Extension
snippet: Cascadia Minerals Ltd. (TSX-V: CAM) released five additional drill results September 1 from its fully funded 2026 program at the road-accessible Carmacks copper-gold project in central Yukon, highlighted by 52.84 metres at 1.04% Cu and 0.37 g/t Au in the 2000S Zone. Step-out drilling extended Zone 2000S 300 metres toward Zone 147, nearly doubling its strike length and opening a 600-metre corridor of sulphide mineralization beyond the existing resource boundary. The 2026 program was expanded from 15,000 to 18,000 metres to chase the northern extension — a capital commitment signalling management conviction in a material resource expansion ahead of a potential resource update.

headline: ASSAYS PENDING NEXT TO CANADA'S LARGEST COPPER MINE — GSP Resource Wraps 1,801m Phase 1 At Alwin High-Grade Gold Discovery In Highland Valley
snippet: GSP Resource Corp. (TSX-V: GSPR) completed an expanded 1,801-metre Phase 1 diamond drilling program at its Alwin Mine and Mer properties in B.C.'s Highland Valley Copper Camp — the same district hosting Teck Resources' Highland Valley mine, Canada's largest copper producer. Four step-out holes (~1,150 metres) were designed to extend the Alwin high-grade gold-copper discovery from 2024, which returned 5.04 g/t Au and 1.01% Cu over 7.90 metres including 22.93 g/t Au over 1.64 metres. All core has been submitted; first assays from the Alwin target are expected in September — an imminent catalyst for a sub-$20M market-cap junior drilling next to a multi-billion-dollar copper operation.

headline: STERLING METALS CLOSES QCX GOLD DEAL — 35,000+ Hectare Batchewana Copper Belt Consolidated; QCX Delisted As Ontario Copper M&A Accelerates
snippet: Sterling Metals Corp. (TSX-V: SAG) completed its acquisition of QcX Gold Corporation effective September 1, 2026, with QcX shares expected to delist from the TSX-V after market close. QcX shareholders received one Sterling share per 4.81026 QcX shares held; former QcX holders now own 9.6% of the combined entity. The deal consolidates over 35,000 hectares across the Batchewana Copper Belt in Northern Ontario, adding multiple copper and gold targets surrounding Sterling's flagship Soo Copper Project. Ontario copper belt consolidation — at $6.60+/lb copper — is part of a broader TSX-V pattern of juniors executing share-only mergers to build district-scale land packages before commodity-driven valuation windows narrow.

headline: GRAPHANO CLEARS PATH TO DRILL BLACK JACK GRAPHITE IN OCTOBER — Quebec Permits Granted On 12-26.5% Cg Discovery; Stripping Starts Sept 15
snippet: Graphano Energy Ltd. (TSX-V: GEL) received two Quebec Ministry of Natural Resources exploration permits on August 31 authorizing mechanical stripping and diamond drilling at its Black Jack graphite discovery, 1 km from the company's Black Pearl discovery. Grab samples at Black Jack returned graphitic carbon values from 12.0% to 26.5% Cg, averaging 19.8% Cg — grades comparable to global premium flake graphite operations. Mechanical stripping begins September 15 and diamond drilling commences October 15. Quebec flake graphite sits at the nexus of North American battery supply chain policy, with the US Inflation Reduction Act requiring increasing percentages of battery materials from allied jurisdictions.

headline: MAGNA TERRA RAISES $2M FLOW-THROUGH WITH INSIDER BUYING — Michael Gentile Participates At 17% Stake In Nova Scotia Gold Exploration Capital
snippet: Magna Terra Minerals Inc. (TSX-V: MTT) announced a non-brokered private placement of C$2 million on September 1, comprising 6,315,789 premium flow-through shares at C$0.2375 and 2,857,143 common shares at C$0.175. Michael Gentile — the company's largest shareholder at 17% — is participating. Proceeds fund qualifying Canadian mineral exploration expenditures under the flow-through share regime. Junior gold flow-through financings with insider-led participation at current gold prices typically signal that management has near-term exploration targets ready to drill and that the tax-incentive premium is being captured at full value rather than negotiated down, suggesting a tight book.

headline: GOLD AND SILVER MINERS STILL DEEPLY UNDERVALUED DESPITE 243% GDX RUN — Phase 2 Re-Rating Has Not Yet Begun, Says GoldSeek Analysis
snippet: A GoldSeek market analysis argues that despite GDX's extraordinary run — up approximately 243% from its February 2026 low — gold and silver mining stocks remain structurally undervalued relative to the metal they mine, the S&P 500, and their own historical earnings multiples at comparable gold price levels. The thesis: the August selloff following Warsh's hawkish remarks completed Phase 1 of the re-rating cycle rather than ending it, with Phase 2 driven by institutional capital recognizing record free cash flow generation at $4,300–4,450 gold and senior producers still trading at multi-decade P/E discounts. The analysis frames September's price pullback as the final accumulation window before the broader market recognizes the sector's earnings transformation.

headline: BANK OF AMERICA HOLDS $130/LB URANIUM — Cameco Mining 19.5M Lbs But Delivering 32M; Supply Gap Is The Structural Bull Case
snippet: The Oregon Group examines why Bank of America maintains its $130/lb uranium price target for 2027 despite market skepticism after uranium's strong August. The key data point: Cameco expects to mine only 19.5–21.5 million pounds in 2026 while committed to deliver 29–32 million pounds to utilities — bridging the gap with inventories and purchased uranium. Westinghouse's reactor pipeline is expanding faster than Cameco's mining capacity, and Kazatomprom has downflexed 2026 production by 10%. At $90.39/lb uranium as of late August, BofA's $130/lb target implies 44% upside — explaining why junior Athabasca Basin uranium developers continue attracting institutional capital even after September's strong sector performance.

headline: PRECIOUS METALS ENTER SEPTEMBER IN CONSOLIDATION — Dealers Report Buying Pause After August Surge; FOMC Decision Is Next Directional Catalyst
snippet: Golden State Mint's August 31 precious metals market report finds gold and silver entering September in a consolidation phase after gold's extraordinary August — the metal's best month since 2020. Physical dealers report elevated but normalising retail buying as investors pause ahead of the September FOMC meeting. With CME FedWatch now showing 66% probability of a rate hike following Warsh's remarks, the report identifies two scenarios: a hike resets near-term metals expectations lower, or a hold re-accelerates August's bull move. September is historically the seasonal low for physical retail precious metals demand before Q4's traditional buying season, historically making this a patient-buyer window.

headline: IDAHO COPPER ADVANCES CuMo PEA WITH $12M FUNDED — NYSE-Listed US Critical Minerals Developer Eyes 18-Month PFS Roadmap At Idaho Copper-Molybdenum Deposit
snippet: Idaho Copper Corporation (NYSE American: COPR) provided its Q2 2026 corporate update September 1, reporting $12.1 million cash on hand following a $18 million public offering completed after its July 2, 2026 NYSE American uplisting under symbols COPR and COPR WS. An updated Preliminary Economic Assessment for the CuMo copper-molybdenum-silver project in Idaho is expected in the near term, followed by an 18-to-24 month Pre-Feasibility Study roadmap. With domestic US copper supply a stated national priority and copper trading above $6.60/lb, a large-scale American copper-molybdenum deposit with NYSE American visibility and a funded PEA-to-PFS pathway occupies an increasingly rare position in the junior critical minerals landscape.
